nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 state variable holding the address of the collateral asset the loan is collateralized with; set once in the constructor.
Immutable address state variable holding the Loan contract address authorized to pull collateral from this locker.
Constructor that initializes the immutable collateralAsset and loan state variables from its arguments.
Modifier that requires msg.sender to equal the loan state variable, reverting otherwise; the access-control gate for pull.
External, isLoan-guarded function that transfers a given amount of the collateral asset to a destination account.
Library function returning a+b with an explicit overflow require check.
Library functions returning a-b, reverting when b>a, with an optional custom error message.
Library function returning a*b with a zero short-cut and a multiplication-overflow require check.
Library functions returning a/b, reverting when the divisor is zero, with an optional custom error message.
Library functions returning a%b, reverting when the divisor is zero, with an optional custom error message.
Library function using inline assembly extcodesize to determine whether an address holds contract code.
Library function that checks balance and sends ether to a payable recipient with a low-level call, reverting on failure.
Library function performing a low-level call to a target with data and optional error message.
Library function validating balance and target contract code, then performing a value-forwarding low-level call and verifying the result.
Library function requiring the target to be a contract and performing a low-level staticcall.
Private helper that returns returndata on success or bubbles the revert reason via inline assembly revert.
Library function encoding an IERC20.transfer call and executing it through _callOptionalReturn.
Library function encoding an IERC20.transferFrom call and executing it through _callOptionalReturn.
Library function requiring a zero starting allowance before encoding an IERC20.approve call.
Library function reading the current allowance, adding the value with SafeMath, and approving the new allowance.
Library function reading the current allowance, subtracting the value with SafeMath, and approving the reduced allowance.
Private helper performing the encoded token call via Address.functionCall and, when return data exists, requiring the decoded boolean to be true.
External ERC20 interface function invoked by SafeERC20.safeTransfer to move tokens to a recipient.
External ERC20 interface function invoked by SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom using the allowance mechanism.
External ERC20 interface function invoked by the SafeERC20 allowance helpers to set spending allowances.
External ERC20 view interface function read by the SafeERC20 allowance helpers and approve guard.
External ERC20 view interface function returning the token balance of an account.
External ERC20 view interface function returning the total token supply.
Caller-controlled message sender used by the isLoan modifier to authorize access to pull.
Arithmetic sum uint256 c = a + b in SafeMath.add, guarded by a require(c >= a) overflow check.
Arithmetic difference uint256 c = a - b in SafeMath.sub, guarded by a require(b <= a) underflow check.
Arithmetic product uint256 c = a * b in SafeMath.mul, guarded by a require(c / a == b) overflow check.
Arithmetic division uint256 c = a / b in SafeMath.div, guarded against a zero divisor.
Arithmetic modulo a % b in SafeMath.mod, guarded against a zero divisor.
Inline assembly extcodesize(account) used by Address.isContract to detect contract code.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue that forwards ether and all available gas to a caller-supplied address.
Low-level target.call{value: value}(data) in Address.functionCallWithValue that forwards arbitrary calldata and value to an external contract.
Low-level target.staticcall(data) in Address.functionStaticCall that executes external read-only code.
Inline assembly revert(add(32, returndata), returndata_size) in Address._verifyCallResult that bubbles up the raw revert reason.
External collateralAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) token call performed by pull, transferring collateral to a caller-specified destination with all gas forwarded.
Constructor parameter carrying the collateral asset token address.
Constructor parameter carrying the authorized Loan contract address.
pull parameter naming the destination account of the collateral transfer.
pull parameter specifying the amount of collateral asset to transfer.

edges.reason: The constructor stores the _collateralAsset parameter into the immutable collateralAsset state variable.
The constructor stores the _loan parameter into the immutable loan state variable.
isLoan compares msg.sender against the loan state variable, making caller identity the access-control input.
isLoan reads the loan state variable as the reference value of its authorization check.
msg.sender must equal loan for pull to execute, so caller identity flows into the guarded function.
The dst parameter is forwarded from pull into safeTransfer as the transfer recipient.
The amt parameter is forwarded from pull into safeTransfer as the transfer amount.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull, reverting for unauthorized callers.
pull invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the collateralAsset token.
pull performs an external token transfer whose control flow leaves the contract before completion.
safeTransfer delegates the encoded call to the internal _callOptionalReturn helper.
safeTransfer encodes the IERC20.transfer selector that ultimately targets the token's transfer function.
safeTransferFrom encodes the IERC20.transferFrom selector as the external call target.
safeApprove encodes the IERC20.approve selector after verifying a zero starting allowance.
safeIncreaseAllowance reads the current allowance before approving.
safeIncreaseAllowance calls approve with the increased allowance value.
safeDecreaseAllowance reads the current allowance before approving.
safeDecreaseAllowance calls approve with the decreased allowance value.
_callOptionalReturn performs the token call through Address.functionCall.
functionCall forwards to functionCallWithValue with zero value.
functionCallWithValue requires the target to hold contract code via isContract.
functionCallWithValue executes a low-level call forwarding arbitrary data and value to an external target.
functionCallWithValue verifies the low-level call result through _verifyCallResult.
_verifyCallResult bubbles the raw revert reason using an inline assembly revert.
sendValue transfers ether with a low-level call that hands control to the recipient before returning.
functionStaticCall requires the target address to be a contract via isContract.
functionStaticCall executes the caller-supplied data with a low-level staticcall.
isContract executes inline assembly extcodesize on the supplied account.
SafeMath.add evaluates the sum uint256 c = a + b before the overflow require.
SafeMath.sub evaluates the subtraction uint256 c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul evaluates the product uint256 c = a * b guarded by require(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div evaluates the division uint256 c = a / b guarded against a zero divisor.
SafeMath.mod evaluates the modulo a % b guarded against a zero divisor.
A malicious collateral token can re-enter pull during the external transfer callback before state effects complete.
The low-level call can re-enter the calling contract before the boolean return value is verified in _callOptionalReturn.
The ether transfer callback can re-enter the calling contract while the balance check result is still pending.

normalization_plan.reason: The _collateralAsset parameter exists only to initialize state inside the constructor and should be absorbed into it.
The _loan parameter exists only to initialize state inside the constructor and should be absorbed into it.
The dst parameter only feeds the external collateral transfer unsafe operation and should be merged into it.
The amt parameter only feeds the external collateral transfer unsafe operation and should be merged into it.
